items.desc: Open-source dots for the web: an AI agent with its own browser, one that does not get blocked.
Open-source research workspace: search academic papers, upload PDFs, inline citations with on-PDF highlights, reader-mode Q&A, and get citation export in four formats.

Baize — an auspicious beast in ancient Chinese mythology that knows all things, now reincarnated as a Vibe Coding assistant.  An open-source AI Coding Agent CLI that supports multiple backends (DeepSeek / OpenAI-compatible / Zhipu / Tongyi / Kimi / local Ollama)
System 1 decision models (Jev, Laya, Cua-S1) as brain for agents: Browser use, computer use, games and robotics
Rules and checks that make Claude Code look around a change, not just at the lines it writes: ten questions before code, a reviewer that didn't write it, proof before done, bugs fixed as a class.
Agent2 — An autonomous AI agent for coding, cybersecurity, terminal automation, and intelligent task execution.

llama.cpp fork for significantly improved performance on Ampere (especially RTX 3090 / 3090 Ti): example: 95+ tok/s over a 100K-token generation at temperature 1 for qwen3.8, supporting full 262K ctx.

🦀⚡ Community skill pack & CLI for Genspark Claw, OpenClaw & Hermes agents — 5 production-ready SKILL.md skills (deep research, reports, slides, browser automation, AI call prep), zero-dependency Node.js installer, MCP server, one-line install
Open-source catalog of go-to-market tools and workflows, written as markdown files any agent can run. Includes a read-only MCP server.

A next-generation AI coding agent built for serious developers — blazing-fast terminal UI, multi-model AI orchestration, autonomous coding, swarm coordination, 40+ tools, and advanced agentic workflows.
A Claude Code skill to make motion design videos in pure code: HTML + Playwright + ffmpeg. No After Effects, no Remotion license.

🛡️ Security audit CLI for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — scan AI agent configs for tool poisoning, rug pulls, hardcoded secrets, command injection & supply-chain risks. Pure Python, SARIF + CI ready.
Local-first recruitment intelligence and application operations agent

Claude Code, Codex and Pi write down everything you do. bough draws it and prices it: a day, the work inside it, every prompt, and what each piece cost. One Go binary, runs on your machine, sends nothing anywhere.
Not another ChatGPT wrapper. This is a local-first tool that turns your notes, web pages, PDFs and audio/video into a personal knowledge graph — running entirely on your own machine.

⚡ Modular prompt-engineering framework for AI Agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot). Forces structured SDLC, linear execution, context isolation, and systematic debugging via a standalone Windows launcher. Stop vibe coding, start agentic discipline! 🚀
An open-source virtual AI Infra team that discovers, benchmarks, and safely upgrades local LLM inference—with independent quality gates, a stable OpenAI-compatible API, and automatic rollback.
A queryable second brain over your scattered notes and docs - hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25), section-level citations, and an MCP server so AI agents can use it. ~300 lines, no LangChain.
Persona agents with explicit memory, retrieval, adversarial smoke tests and a practical post-training roadmap.

A local app that rents a GPU in your own Colab account and serves Qwen3.8 on it: 27B on an A100-40G, or Flash-Next (125B-A6B MoE) on an A100-80G. The cost is shown before it starts; chat with images; Codex or any OpenAI client uses a fixed local /v1. Auto-stop, CU ledger, live prefill/decode. Windows, macOS, Linux.
